<?php
namespace App\Service;

interface Sender { public function send(string $m); }

class Mailer implements Sender {
    use Loud;
    public function send(string $m) { $this->deliver($m); }
    private function deliver($m) { echo $m; }
    private function dead_private() {}
    public function dead_public() {}
    public function __toString() { return 'm'; }
}

trait Loud { public function shout() { return 1; } }

class Unused extends Mailer {}
